text: You are on the support-desk app in this directory. Callers of the refund desk need a receipt they can store. When `refundAgent` issues a refund, the response of that turn must carry an artifact named `receipt-<refundId>` (for example `receipt-R-1001`) with one data part `{ refundId: string, orderId: string, amount: number }` describing the refund it issued. A declined refund has no receipt. Keep the rest of the refund desk as it is. Keep the existing flows and their exports. Don't change `package.json` or add dependencies.
